import gc
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

root = Path('/mnt/sdab1/userHome/wslim/.codex/worktrees/aa40/compression-gap-cl/.worktrees/ease-sizes')
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
from scripts.cl_runtime import configure_native_environment
configure_native_environment()
import torch
from backbone.ease_vit import EaseViT
from scripts.ease_size_protocol import VARIANTS, load_variant, canonical_pretrained_digest

torch.set_num_threads(2)
records = []
for name in VARIANTS:
    variant = load_variant(name)
    model = EaseViT(100, vit_size=variant['vit_size'], pretrained=False,
                    ease_checkpoint=variant['checkpoint_file'], adapter_size=variant['adapter_size'])
    digest = canonical_pretrained_digest(model.backbone)
    assert digest == variant['canonical_pretrained_sha256']
    assert model.feature_dim == variant['feature_dim']
    assert len(model.backbone.blocks) == 12
    assert all(block.attn.num_heads == variant['num_heads'] for block in model.backbone.blocks)
    assert not any(parameter.requires_grad for parameter in model.backbone.parameters())
    model.start_task()
    adapter_count = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.adapters[0].parameters())
    assert adapter_count == variant['adapter_parameters_per_task_estimate']
    assert all(tuple(adapter.down_proj.weight.shape) == (variant['adapter_size'], variant['feature_dim'])
               and tuple(adapter.up_proj.weight.shape) == (variant['feature_dim'], variant['adapter_size'])
               for adapter in model.adapters[0])
    records.append({'variant': name, 'status': 'pass', 'image_forwards': 0, 'gpu_used': False,
                    'checkpoint_sha256': variant['checkpoint_sha256'],
                    'initial_canonical_pretrained_sha256': digest, 'canonical_tensor_count': 150,
                    'feature_dim': model.feature_dim, 'num_heads': variant['num_heads'],
                    'adapter_size': variant['adapter_size'], 'adapter_parameters': adapter_count})
    print(name + ': actual native CPU construction passed', flush=True)
    del model
    gc.collect()
target = root / 'benchmarks/cl_efficiency/ease_sizes/environment/native_cpu_initialization.json'
target.write_text(json.dumps({'status': 'pass', 'variants': records}, indent=2) + '\n')
